name: Total Chaos Retro Edition
tagline: Survival horror set on a remote island known as Fort Oasis
blurb: Survival horror set on a remote island known as Fort Oasis.
description:
Survival horror set on a remote island known as Fort Oasis.
The island was once run by a community of coal miners which one day suddenly disappeared.
Something, clearly, has gone very wrong with this place.
Upon your arrival at Fort Oasis, you receive a strange radio transmission.
Someone wants to be found.
Survive in 6 chapters, against over 8 horrifying fiends with a large assortment of weapons.

Retro Edition has reduced texture resolution and poly-counts for improved performance.
Save files from other versions of Total Chaos are not compatible.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
